description: This file defines an interface named CookieJarInterface within the GuzzleHttp\Cookie namespace. It specifies methods for managing HTTP cookies, including adding, extracting, and removing cookies, as well as converting the cookie jar to an array. The interface extends IteratorAggregate and Countable, indicating collection-like behavior.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Creates and returns a request object with added cookie headers based on the stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from the HTTP response and stores them in the cookie jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the cookie jar; returns true if successful.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies based on optional domain, path, and name parameters; can clear all cookies.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes all session cookies, typically called during shutdown.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the cookie jar contents into an array format.
